LanguageData.VRESaurids_EggFatigue.description: After laying an egg, it is common with those with the oviparous gene to go through a short period of sterility till they are capable of producing another. This is only a temporary condition and causes no long term effects.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_EggFatigue.label: egg fatigue
LanguageData.VRESaurids_HyperthermicSlowdown.descript: This pawn is cold blooded and their body will begin to shut down when too hot, it has the benefit of slowing their metabolism so they have a lower hunger rate however the longer this goes on the worse it will affect their capabilities up to the point where they die.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_HyperthermicSlowdown.label: hyperthermic slowdown
LanguageData.VRESaurids_HypothermicSlowdown.descripti: This pawn is cold blooded and their body will begin to shut down when too cold, it has the benefit of slowing their metabolism so they have a lower hunger rate however the longer this goes on the worse it will affect their capabilities up to the point where they die.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_HypothermicSlowdown.label: hypothermic slowdown
